registered: 2026-10-27, after a 2-item smoke test (slice-8 dev items B07GFLG5MM, B07B4SB2D9) and before any other run
render: src/eval/appearance-render.ts: 8 azimuths at 20° elevation, 256 px, compareMeshShapes placement; albedo pass (unlit map×colour, no tone mapping) and lit pass (fixed neutral studio light)
metrics: src/eval/appearance-metrics.ts: deltaE00 (CIEDE2000 median on the shared mask), histogram (Lab 8x8x8 intersection on each own mask), detailRatio (candidate/reference mean Sobel L* in eroded masks), ssimAlbedo, ssimLit, maskIoU; per item = mean over views

phaseA.purpose: metric validity on identical geometry with controlled appearance damage
phaseA.controls: self (reference vs itself), flat (each view's mean visible colour, linear-light), hue (a*,b* negated), grey (#808080 materials rendered)
criteria: V1 determinism: self deltaE00 = 0 and detailRatio = 1 on every item
V2 detail axis: flat detailRatio <= 0.1 on >= 9/10 items, and hue detailRatio within [0.9, 1.1] on >= 9/10 items
V3 colour axis: grey deltaE00 > flat deltaE00 on >= 9/10 items
phaseA.note: hue changes deltaE00 little on near-achromatic items; it is a detail-axis control, not a colour-axis criterion

phaseB.purpose: appearance gap of LLM-written IRs, the baseline for texture work
phaseB.items: slice-9b test, repeat r1 (benchmarks/oss-integration-20261026/abo-multiview/test-sonnet-r1), arms a1 and a2; same items also scored with the phase-A controls for reference
phaseB.comparisons: each IR vs the same IR painted #808080 (isolates the model's colour choices from its shape)
criteria: B1 colour choice helps: median paired (IR - grey IR) deltaE00 < 0 with bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 0 (items, 10k resamples, seed 20261027), for a2
B2 descriptive: report IR detailRatio median and the flat-control deltaE00 median as the untextured ceiling
